report.summary: No blocking issues. Claude's default mode is now `auto` everywhere it is set: spec 01 Agents table, the Workspace DO (queue.ts), the web and Mac plan-mode toggles (rule 17 is met), and the conformance harness and README. The recorded adapter output (docs/evidence/core/claude.json) lists `auto`. The new turn-summary text matches between spec 01 and TURN_SUMMARY_RULE, and worker tests use the constant. The tests that checked for `bypassPermissions` were updated. IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES records the owner's decision. Three small issues remain. Review was read-only; typecheck, lint and tests were not run.

findings.text: The Mac plan-toggle test covers only Codex and Pi. No Mac test checks that leaving plan mode for a Claude session returns to `auto`, although the web logic test does. Add a Claude case so the changed line has a test.
This line still explains IS_SANDBOX=1 by saying Claude Code hides `bypassPermissions` for root. That mode is no longer the default, so update the reason or confirm it still applies.

The note says that if an adapter does not offer `auto`, tempod logs the failed mode change and keeps the current mode. Spec 01 does not state this for modes; it only gives that fallback for model and reasoning level. Point to where this behavior is specified or implemented.
